name: 07-schema-run
title: psql — схема развёрнута: таблицы и число колонок
sql:
SELECT table_name AS таблица, (SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns c WHERE c.table_name = t.table_name) AS колонок
FROM information_schema.tables t
WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_type = 'BASE TABLE'
ORDER BY table_name;

name: 14-login-postman
title: Вход: POST /api/auth/login
command:

$b='http://localhost:5080'
$r = curl.exe -s -X POST "$b/api/auth/login" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"username":"admin","password":"Admin123!"}' | ConvertFrom-Json
'Пользователь: ' + $r.data.user.fullName + ' / роль ' + $r.data.user.role
'Токен: ' + $r.data.token.Substring(0, 40) + '…'
'Длина токена: ' + $r.data.token.Length + ' символов'

name: 15-401-403-run
title: 401 без токена и 403 при чужой роли
command:
$ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Console]::OutputEncoding=[Text.Encoding]::UTF8; $OutputEncoding=[Text.Encoding]::UTF8
$b='http://localhost:5080'
'1. Без токена:'
curl.exe -s -o NUL -w '   GET /api/work-orders -> %{http_code}' "$b/api/work-orders"
''
'2. Токен мастера, отчёт (нужна роль MANAGER/ADMIN):'
$r = curl.exe -s -X POST "$b/api/auth/login" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"username":"master","password":"Master123!"}' | ConvertFrom-Json
curl.exe -s -o NUL -w '   POST /api/reports -> %{http_code}' -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $($r.data.token)" "$b/api/reports"
''
'3. Тот же запрос с токеном менеджера:'
$m = curl.exe -s -X POST "$b/api/auth/login" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"username":"manager","password":"Manager123!"}' | ConvertFrom-Json
curl.exe -s -o NUL -w '   POST /api/reports -> %{http_code}' -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $($m.data.token)" "$b/api/reports"
